MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The thread checker feels useful because identifying loose threaded hardware could help me find matching replacements during household repairs.",
    "The multi-purpose oil fits the same repair work as my fastening supplies: I could use it to maintain tools or lubricate hinges."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts and adhesive tape are related to fastening, but neither meets my current need for nails and wood screws; the connection alone does not give me a reason to buy them.",
    "Battery terminals, milling cutters, a wire gauge, and a thermometer require specific tasks I have not shown a need for.",
    "Small dispensing cups do not imply that I need glass beakers, and replacement vacuum bags do not imply that I need a twelve-pack of wastebaskets."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in repair supplies seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop tool or hardware.",
    "Shared purposes such as measuring, mounting, or cleaning seem to count too much when the actual task and quantity differ."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated interest in framing nails and wood screws points toward specific fastening jobs, where dimensions and compatibility matter.",
    "I choose supplies when I can see a practical use for them now; a related item needs a clear role in my repairs before I would select it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my household repair needs but stretched them into specialized tasks and supplies I do not currently need."
}
